messages:
Jordan (Eng Manager): Hey team 1 We have a comp+promo ask off-cycle for Sam (contractor -> perm + level up). What's the shortest path?
Maya (People Ops): Congrats! Short path: run conversion through hiring ops (offer packet) and include promo request in the offer notes so comp reviews concurrently.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can we retro base to contractor earnings?
Ibrahim (Comp): No — contractor invoices don't convert to salary retro. You can request a promo effective date on the hire date, but payroll won't backpay contractor invoices.
Jordan (Eng Manager): What about equity and sign-on?
Maya (People Ops): Include equity ask in the offer; comp will recommend grant size. Off-cycle equity >1.25x target needs Director signoff. Sign-on can be used for retention if needed.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Evidence needed?
Ibrahim (Comp): Short bullets: role before/after, 3 impact examples with dates, internal comparables, proposed base & equity.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Payroll timing?
Nina (Payroll): If you need salary change in next payroll, have fully signed comp + offer accepted >5 business days before cutoff. For retro within 90 days comp approval required.
offer-bot: Reminder: next payroll cutoff is 2112345695 UTC. Submissions after cutoff process next cycle.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Any international caveats (they're UK-based)?
Maya (People Ops): For UK we require local comp signoff and immigration check if visa holder. Also confirm gross vs net implications and include currency in form.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks 1 I'll draft the offer + promo pack and tag you for review.
Maya (People Ops): Happy to review 1 send draft here or DM. Avoid pasting personal docs in thread.
